# PROJECT CONVENTIONS for holtburger-web: tests/JS gate, suite hygiene, console allowlist, URL-flag lints and docs, lazy-load pattern, service worker/serve.py/shell bundle/modulepreload, Node CLI style, Claude Code skill/agent packaging, git
Paths below are relative to HB=$REPO/external/holtburger/apps/holtburger-web unless they start with scripts/ (= $REPO/external/holtburger/scripts) or $REPO. I read every file:line cited with verified=true. I ran nothing heavy: no gate, no lint, no browser, no WBT.

Q1. HOW TO ADD TESTS TO THE JS GATE
- Registration is an explicit hand list, not a glob. The gate is `node harness/run-js-headless.mjs` (= `npm test` in package.json; CI runs `node harness/run-js-headless.mjs --quiet`).
- The list is three arrays: TIER1 (lines 99-160), TIER4 (164-197) and TIER5 (215-1037). New suites go at the end of TIER5, before `];` at line 1037, as `{ tier: 5, flag: "<free-text label>", file: "<path relative to the app root>" }`.
  - `flag` is only a label for `--only=` filtering. It is not tied to url-flags.md.
  - Optional `requires: "<path>" | () => path` names an external fixture. If it is absent the row is NO-FIXTURE: not run, and not a pass.
- The COVERAGE GUARD `unregisteredSuites()` (1090-1121) fails the full run (exit 1) for any unregistered file matching these patterns:
  - root `test_*.mjs`
  - `rynth/test_*.mjs`
  - `harness/test_*.mjs`
  - `tests/` files named `test_*` or `*.test.*` with .mjs/.cjs
  - root `test_*.cjs`
  - `harness/glsl_smoke/*_smoke.mjs`
- Root `test_*.cjs` files are by convention headless-Chrome GPU smokes. They must be listed in NEEDS_BROWSER (1073-1085) and must not be in a tier; harness/test_gate_browser_smokes.mjs asserts that. Pure-node CJS tests go in `tests/*.test.cjs`.
- Directories are not scanned recursively. A new `film/` directory, or `tests/film/`, is invisible to the guard, so rot there would go unnoticed. Put suites in `tests/film_<topic>.test.mjs` and helpers in `tests/helpers/`.
- How the runner executes each suite (runOne 1271-1310):
  - a child `node <file>` with cwd = app root, `--max-old-space-size=1536` (HB_TEST_HEAP_MB), 120 s timeout;
  - exit 0 = PASS, non-zero = FAIL;
  - exit 0 plus a SKIP banner (regex 1238-1241, e.g. `X: SKIP —`) = SKIP, which counts as FAIL unless `--allow-skips`;
  - QUARANTINE (1045) must name a real bug.
- The full run takes harness/lib/heavy_lock.mjs: a machine-wide lock at /tmp/hb-heavy.lock plus MemAvailable ≥ 2560 MB. Exit 2 means the lock was refused. A single `node tests/x.test.mjs` takes no lock.
- `--coverage` and `--list` only read directories; they take no lock.
- Rynth has a second runner, `node rynth_test_all_node.cjs`, which globs root `rynth_*_test.cjs`. rynth_ai_client_test.cjs runs only there.
- Test style:
  - plain ESM `.mjs`, `import assert from "node:assert/strict"`;
  - a local `check(name, fn)` / `test()` wrapper printing `[OK]`/`[PASS]`/`[FAIL]`;
  - a final `<suite>: N passed, M failed` line, then `process.exit(1)` or `process.exitCode = 1` on failure;
  - a header comment stating WHY, the flag, DEFAULT OFF/ON, the retail decomp cites, and `Run: node tests/x.test.mjs (from apps/holtburger-web/)`.
- Stubbing three.js:
  - Real `three` 0.184.0 is in node_modules (`import * as THREE from "three"` or `await import("three")`). Prefer it: real Quaternion/Matrix/slerp math works in Node.
  - `harness/lib/locate_three.mjs` `requireThree()` treats a missing three as FAIL.
  - `_three_stub.mjs` is a tracked minimal stub (Vector3/Quaternion with no methods, Object3D, Mesh…). `_three_stub_loader.mjs` is a Node resolve hook. Install with `register(pathToFileURL(resolve(__dirname,"../_three_stub_loader.mjs")).href)` before importing app modules (tests/carnage_hit_guard.test.mjs:26-31).
- Stubbing window: `globalThis.window = { location: { search: "" }, … }` before the import. For DOM, use the hand-rolled fake DOMs in tests/helpers/ (`installFakeDom`, etc.); there is no jsdom.
- For modules that cannot load headless:
  - `harness/lib/import_edited.mjs` `importEdited(relPath, edit)` loads the real module with a one-line test seam;
  - `harness/lib/splice_module.mjs` plus `harness/lib/scene3d_stubs.mjs` splice it into `new Function`.

Q2. RULES NEW FILES MUST SATISFY
- (a) Suite hygiene (harness/test_suite_hygiene.mjs, shrink-only ratchet against harness/source-pin-baseline.json, 31 entries).
  - A new suite that reads app source text (fs read of a scene3d/ app/ src/ plugins/ ui/ rynth/ path or index.html) without importing or executing app code is PURE-PIN, and that fails.
  - New suites must EXECUTE shipped code.
- (b) Console allowlist (harness/lib/console_allowlist.mjs plus harness/test_console_allowlist.mjs).
  - Zero console errors / pageerrors in browser runs, after subtracting ALLOWLIST (one entry: QuickEmote 0x13).
  - A new entry needs id, regex pattern, `evidence` with a file:line or `docs/` cite (EVIDENCE_RE line 83), and `added: YYYY-MM-DD`.
  - Film-mode code must not console.error in normal operation.
- (c) scripts/lint-url-flags.mjs (CI).
  - Sweeps scene3d/** + app/** + index.html for `URLSearchParams…get("x")` within ±10 lines of URLSearchParams/location.search, plus regex `[?&]x=` readers.
  - Fails on OFF-SPELLING (`!== "off"` when the docs row promises 0/false) and on PRESENCE-GUARD / DIVERGENT.
  - UNDOCUMENTED is advisory unless `--strict`. scripts/net-review/ci-smoke.sh:43 does run `--strict`.
- (d) scripts/audit-flag-defaults.mjs (CI).
  - Sweeps scene3d, app, index.html, plugins, rynth, netbrain.
  - Hard-fails when the docs Default-cell polarity mismatches the reader, and when an in-code comment within 6 lines above the reader says "default OFF" while the reader resolves ON (or the reverse).
- (e) scripts/lint-harness-params.mjs (ci-smoke L3). Any `?param=` emitted by harness/**, scripts/multi-agent/**, net-review/** or perf-worker/** must have a JS reader or a url-flags.md row.
- (f) scripts/lint-event-consumers.mjs (CI).
  - Plugin-bus handlers must read `ev.detail` (DETAIL-UNREAD fails `(p)=>p.guid`).
  - A newly emitted bus name needs a subscriber or an EXTENSION_POINTS entry.
- (g) docs/url-flags.md rows are parsed by `^\| \`flag\`(=…)? \|`. Rows must start at column 0; blockquoted `> |` rows are invisible to the lints.
  - Main-table format: `| Flag | Values | Default | Reader (semantics when absent) | Effect | Where |`, e.g. §1 header at line 220, §4 Dev/debug at 504, §5 Login/automation at 661.
  - §0 (lines 3-61) is a BLOCKQUOTED adjudication table: `> | Flag | Why it is OFF | Evidence that would flip it | Status |`. Every deliberately default-OFF flag gets a §0 row. Film mode fits the "Harness / boot contract params" class (row 54).
  - Newer dated `### YYYY-MM-DD — …` sections use a 4-column `| Flag | What it does | Eye-test | Pass criteria |` table (1682-1687) with `\`flag\`=on (default **OFF**)` in the first cell. audit-flag-defaults then reads the Eye-test cell as Default, so prefer the 6-column main-table row.
  - Escape literal `|` inside cells as `\|`.
- (h) File naming: suites as above. No new Worker sites without updating WORKER_ENTRIES (scripts/build-shell.mjs:101-107), or the shell build throws. No SharedWorker.

Q3. LAZY-LOAD PATTERN AND FLAG READING
- House reader grammar: an exported, injectable, optionally memoised reader. Examples:
  - scene3d/selection_lighting.js:81-93 `selectionFlashEnabled(search)`: `new URLSearchParams(q).get("selectionFlash") === "on"`, try/catch → false, and a `_set…ForTest` hook. Tested at tests/selection_lighting.test.mjs:272-279 against `""`, `?x`, `?x=1`, `?x=true`, `?x=ON`, `?x=off` → all false.
  - scene3d/residency_grid.js:67-78 `slotGridEnabled(search)`: on/1/true/yes allowlist.
  - Keep the comparison on the same line as `.get()` (residency_grid.js:58) so audit-flag-defaults classifies it.
- The footgun: `!== "off"` means ABSENT ⇒ ON. Only an exact match (`=== "on"` or `=== "1"`) is a real opt-in (docs/url-flags.md:79-80). `=== "off"` over a true default is also ON.
- Zero-cost lazy-import examples:
  - (1) scene3d/index.js:4429-4444: right after `window.liveScene3d = liveScene3d` (4420), `if (new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("dismember") !== "off") import("./dismember.js").then(m=>m.installDismemberDiag()).catch(err=>console.warn("[dismember] failed to load:",err))`, and the same for carnage. This is the right placement and shape, but those flags are default-ON; film mode needs `=== "on"`.
  - (2) rynth/bot.js:1100-1103: `if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("thoughtOverlay") === "1") import(\`${base}/ai/thought_overlay.js\`).then(...).catch(e=>console.warn(...))`. This is a strict opt-in; the module is never statically imported and never preloaded.
- Counter-example (not zero cost despite its comment): index.html:2476-2483 `?packSource` (and the geomBundles block at 2664-2676) does `await import("./scene3d/pack_fetch_controller.js")` only when on. But scripts/gen-modulepreload.mjs seeds literal dynamic imports from index.html AND every app/*.js (lines 97-117), so the module is in the modulepreload block (index.html:1226) and is fetched and parsed on every boot.
  - Rule: put the flag-gated `import("./film/…")` inside a scene3d module (the crawl follows static imports only), not in index.html or app/.
  - app/ is wrong for lazy-only code anyway: harness/test_build_shell.mjs:254-256 asserts every app/*.js is modulepreloaded.
  - Making a film module statically reachable from the boot graph changes the pinned `NON_APP_PRELOADS = 402` (test_build_shell.mjs:345-346). That needs a gen-modulepreload re-run plus a hand-edited pin bump.

Q4. SERVING, SERVICE WORKER AND SHELL FOR NEW FILES
- serve.py serves the whole external/holtburger tree (Handler directory=HOLT_ROOT, 658-683) with `Cache-Control: no-cache` for .js/.mjs (836-888). New files are served with no registration.
- The service worker never intercepts JS/HTML/wasm/manifest.json. It only touches `/shards/` (CAS), `boot.hba`, `manifest/*.bin` (bake-gated) and `/scene3d/assets/` (stale-while-revalidate) (service-worker.js:197-225, 442-444, 459-463). New JS dirs need no SW listing.
  - Film assets placed under scene3d/assets/ would become stale-while-revalidate.
  - The MEMORY note that the SW caches index.html is contradicted by the current code. `?nosw=1` still applies (index.html:2349).
- The bundled shell is the real constraint. scripts/build-shell.mjs stages only `BUNDLED_DIRS = ["scene3d","plugins","ui","rynth","app"]` (109; walkFiles at 138 is recursive), then runs esbuild with `--bundle` and no splitting.
  - A literal import of a top-level `film/` module from bundled code cannot resolve in the staged tree. I expect esbuild to error; that esbuild behaviour is unverified.
  - harness/test_build_shell.mjs runs the real build twice when /mnt/wbterminal2/reeng/T11/bin/esbuild exists (it does locally). On CI it is NO-FIXTURE.
  - shell-manifest.json is generated and gitignored (510 inputs). Its `inputs` going stale only makes the proxy serve unbundled until its background rebuild. Nothing has to list new files by hand.
- Use `scene3d/film/` (subdirectory precedent: scene3d/motion, particles, vfx, audio, diag). It is bundled, swept by both flag lints, the event lint and hygiene, and served.
- Import stateful scene3d modules carefully. scene3d/index.js imports `./terrain.js?v=phase-d-batch`, `./buildings.js?v=phase-d-batch` and `./statics.js?v=phase7-par` (38/49/54), and index.html imports `./scene3d/index.js?v=diag-followons-2026-05-23` (3868). A different specifier gives a second module instance on the unbundled arm. Inject dependencies, or use `window.liveScene3d`.

Q5. CLAUDE CODE PACKAGING
- The only existing skill is worldbuilder-terminal, kept as two separate identical copies (cmp: identical), not symlinks:
  - ~/.claude/skills/worldbuilder-terminal/SKILL.md (31,121 B, plus on-demand companion commands.md, plus evals/evals.json `{skill_name, evals:[{id,name,prompt,…}]}` and evals/trigger-eval.json `[{query, should_trigger}]`, the skill-creator format);
  - $REPO/.claude/skills/worldbuilder-terminal/skill.md (lowercase, git-tracked).
- Frontmatter uses only `name` and `description` (~/.claude/skills/discord-list/SKILL.md has the same two).
- No agents directory exists in ~/.claude or $REPO/.claude.
- The user's usual cwd is /home/wbterminal, so ~/.claude is both user and project scope there. Install:
  - the skill at ~/.claude/skills/film-mode/SKILL.md;
  - the agent at ~/.claude/agents/<name>.md (frontmatter name/description/tools/model: opus; this field set is from Claude Code knowledge, not read on disk).
- Keep the canonical copy versioned at $REPO/.claude/skills/film-mode/SKILL.md (uppercase) and $REPO/.claude/agents/<name>.md, and symlink the ~/.claude paths to them to avoid drift. Whether a lowercase `skill.md` is discovered is unverified.
- `.claude/worktrees/` is gitignored; `.claude/skills` and `.claude/agents` would be tracked.
- ~/CLAUDE.md requires the laptop resource rules to be copied verbatim into every agent prompt. The MEMORY note requires agent briefs to forbid pushing and self-armed git automation.
- ~/.claude/settings.json PreToolUse hooks block Write/Edit and Bash redirects into memory/.
- Enabled plugins include chrome-devtools-mcp and skill-creator.
- Per the relayed user note: the agent is the Claude Code session on the Opus subscription. No Anthropic SDK, API key or API call goes in code. Only the JEV/OpenRouter client makes API calls.

Q6. NODE CLI AND COMMIT CONVENTIONS
- CLIs:
  - ESM `.mjs` with `#!/usr/bin/env node` and a long WHY/WHAT/USAGE header;
  - hand-rolled argv parsing, never node:util parseArgs. `--key=value` via `arg(k, default)` (harness/moving-bench.mjs:126-133; scripts/multi-agent/fleet.mjs:35-46), or `--key value` (tools/clip-alpha-gate.mjs:424-434);
  - an exported `main()` behind an importable main-guard `if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(path.resolve(process.argv[1])).href) main().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(2)})` (clip-alpha-gate.mjs:543-548; test_suite_hygiene.mjs:584);
  - exit codes 0 = ok, 1 = finding/failure, 2 = usage/env/lock refused (moving-bench adds 3 = ratchet regression).
- `.cjs` is used only for legacy capture_*.cjs scripts and the rynth_*_test.cjs suites.
- Browser drivers:
  - Do `await acquireHeavyLock({label})`, then `const {chromium}=await import("playwright-core")`, then `chromium.connectOverCDP(CDP)` to an already-running Chrome, then `page.evaluate` (moving-bench.mjs:447-453).
  - lib/boot.mjs `launchAndEnter` forces `nullRender=1` (68-81), so it is useless for filming.
  - Prior-art recorder: capture_canvas_video.cjs (MediaRecorder + canvas.captureStream → .webm, RECORD_* env knobs, @teleloc waypoints).
- Git: external/holtburger is NOT a submodule. There is no .gitmodules, no .git inside it, and `git -C external/holtburger rev-parse --show-toplevel` returns $REPO. It is vendored in the parent repo on branch master (in sync with origin/master), so there are no submodule bumps.
- Commit style:
  - subject `<area>: <plain-English user-visible outcomes, comma/em-dash list>`, where area is mostly `holtburger-web`, also `holtburger`, `holtburger docs`, `holtburger tools`;
  - body: a prose paragraph, then `- ` bullets wrapped near 100 columns, then "Still to do…", then `Tests: N new gate suites; full JS gate X/Y …` or `Gate: JS 695/0, rynth node 68/0/32, … lints clean`, plus a docs/HANDOFF-<topic>-YYYY-MM-DD.md pointer;
  - trailer `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>`; author salvia420-bit.
- CI is $REPO/.github/workflows/holtburger-ci.yml, with path filter `external/holtburger/**`. Its js job runs npm ci, run-js-headless --quiet, gen-client-event-kinds --check, lint-url-flags, lint-event-consumers and audit-flag-defaults.

Also notable: `?hud=none` (index.html:614 adds `no-hud`; CSS 527-539 hides every overlay except #stage), `?plugins=none` (app/plugin_bar.js:476-485) and `?camDebug=on` → `window.__cam` free-camera rig with park() (scene3d/camera.js:463-470, 1440-1531) are existing default-inert hooks for HUD-free shots. rynth/ai/llm_client.js (frozen interface) is the in-tree OpenRouter transport, and rynth_ai_client_test.cjs is the template for mocking the provider with an in-process http server.

## APIS
- run-js-headless (the JS gate) [apps/holtburger-web/harness/run-js-headless.mjs:36]  sig=node harness/run-js-headless.mjs [--only=substr,...] [--tier=1|4|all] [--quiet] [--list] [--coverage] [--strict-missing] [--timeout=MS] [--bail] [--allow-skips] [--run-quarantined] [--strict-fixtures] :: Explicit-list runner over TIER1 (99), TIER4 (164) and TIER5 (215-1037). Each suite runs as a child node process with cwd = app root and a 1536 MB heap cap. Exit 0 = pass. A SKIP banner fails by default. Exit 1 on FAIL or UNREGISTERED; exit 2 when the heavy lock is refused. Also `npm test` (package.json). --coverage and --list take no lock.
- unregisteredSuites() coverage guard [apps/holtburger-web/harness/run-js-headless.mjs:1090]  sig=function unregisteredSuites(): string[] :: SCAN patterns (1098-1110): root test_*.mjs, rynth/test_*.mjs, harness/test_*.mjs, tests/(test_*|*.test.*).(mjs|cjs), root test_*.cjs (browser smokes) and harness/glsl_smoke/*_smoke.mjs. Not recursive. A file matching these that is in no tier, QUARANTINE, NEEDS_TOOLCHAIN or NEEDS_BROWSER fails the full run.
- TIER5 registration entry [apps/holtburger-web/harness/run-js-headless.mjs:1037]  sig={ tier: 5, flag: "<label>", file: "tests/<name>.test.mjs", requires?: string | () => string } :: Append new suites before the closing `];` at 1037. `requires` names an external fixture path (absent = NO-FIXTURE, not run), e.g. harness_build_shell at 652-653 requires the esbuild binary.

A new suite that reads app source (scene3d/app/src/plugins/ui/rynth/index.html) and executes no app code fails. HB_REGEN_SOURCE_PIN=1 can only shrink the baseline.

## HAZARDS
- [scripts/build-shell.mjs:109] A top-level `apps/holtburger-web/film/` directory imported from app code (literal specifier) is not staged by build-shell (BUNDLED_DIRS excludes it). esbuild then likely fails to resolve it; that esbuild behaviour is unverified. harness/test_build_shell.mjs runs the real build locally because the esbuild binary is present, so the local gate goes red. film/ is also invisible to lint-url-flags, audit-flag-defaults, lint-event-consumers, hygiene and the coverage guard. || mitig: Put in-page code under scene3d/film/ (or app/rynth/plugins/ui). Otherwise extend BUNDLED_DIRS and every lint sweep list together. Node-only agent tooling that the app never imports can live in tools/film/.
- [apps/holtburger-web/harness/test_build_shell.mjs:345] index.html and app/*.js literal dynamic import() calls are SEEDED into the modulepreload block, so they are fetched and parsed on every boot. This is not zero cost: index.html:2476-2483 packSource claims 'not even imported on the OFF arm', yet pack_fetch_controller.js sits at index.html:1226. test_build_shell also asserts every app/*.js is preloaded and pins NON_APP_PRELOADS=402. || mitig: Gate and import inside a scene3d module (scene3d/index.js ~4420). Never import film code statically from the boot graph. If that ever changes, re-run `node scripts/gen-modulepreload.mjs` and bump NON_APP_PRELOADS with a dated comment.
- [scripts/audit-flag-defaults.mjs:286] Flag footgun: `!== "off"` (or `=== "off"` over a true default) resolves ON when the param is absent. audit-flag-defaults hard-fails when a comment within 6 lines above the reader says 'default OFF' while the reader resolves ON, and when the docs Default cell disagrees with the reader. || mitig: Use exact `=== "on"` on the same line as .get(); write the docs Default cell as `off`; pin it with a test over ["","?filmMode","?filmMode=1","?filmMode=true","?filmMode=ON","?filmMode=off"] → false.
- [apps/holtburger-web/docs/url-flags.md:40] url-flags.md: blockquoted `> |` §0 rows are invisible to the lints, so they do not satisfy a docs-row requirement. A non-blockquoted §0 row shadows the real main-table row in audit-flag-defaults because the first row wins (perPolyCull: line 40 shadows line 302). The newer 4-column dated tables put the default in the flag cell, and the audit reads the Eye-test column as Default. || mitig: Write a 6-column main-table row (§4/§5) and a separate `> |`-prefixed §0 row. Escape `|` inside cells.
- [apps/holtburger-web/harness/run-js-headless.mjs:1238] Gate classification traps: a suite that prints `X: SKIP —` and exits 0 is counted as FAIL. A root `test_*.cjs` is treated as a browser smoke and must be in NEEDS_BROWSER, not a tier. Unregistered suites fail the full run. Subdirectories of tests/ are not scanned. || mitig: Use .mjs under tests/ with a .test.mjs suffix and register it in TIER5. Give external fixtures a `requires:`. Never print a SKIP banner from a suite that should pass.
- [apps/holtburger-web/harness/test_suite_hygiene.mjs:19] Suite hygiene: a new test that only regex-matches app source text (scene3d/app/… or index.html) without importing it fails the PURE-PIN ratchet. || mitig: Import and execute the real film modules (pure-function design makes this easy). Use importEdited for seams.
- [apps/holtburger-web/scene3d/index.js:38] Module double-instancing: scene3d/index.js imports terrain/buildings/statics with `?v=` cache-busters (38/49/54), and index.html imports scene3d/index.js?v=diag-followons-2026-05-23 (3868). A film module importing the same file without the identical query gets a separate module instance with separate state on the unbundled arm. The bundled arm collapses them, so the two arms behave differently. || mitig: Inject dependencies through installFilmMode({...}) or read window.liveScene3d (note: a one-time snapshot). Do not import stateful scene3d modules directly.

## RECS
- Layout: in-page runtime under apps/holtburger-web/scene3d/film/ (bundled, linted, hygiene-scanned). Agent-side Node tooling (plan compiler, JEV client, song/lyric analysis, CDP recorder) as ESM .mjs under tools/film/ or harness/film-*.mjs. Tests under tests/film_*.test.mjs with helpers in tests/helpers/.
- Flag: a single `?filmMode=on` exact-match reader `filmModeEnabled(search)` (memoised, injectable, `_setFilmModeEnabledForTest`) in scene3d/film/. Lazily `import("./film/index.js")` from scene3d/index.js right after window.liveScene3d is set (~4420), with `.catch(e=>console.warn("[film] failed to load:", e))`. No static import from the boot graph, so no modulepreload or NON_APP_PRELOADS change.
- Docs: add a 6-column row to docs/url-flags.md §4 or §5 (Default `off`, Reader `=== "on"` opt-in, Where scene3d/film/…). Add a blockquoted §0 row ('agent/contract param — flipping on would hijack a human session; never flips'). Add rows for every film sub-param a driver emits.
- Testability: keep shot math (quaternion paths without gimbal flips, easing, obstruction scoring, plan schema validation) in pure modules that take THREE plus state as arguments. Test them with real node_modules three and node:assert/strict, and register each suite in TIER5 of harness/run-js-headless.mjs before line 1037.
- Recording drivers: acquireHeavyLock({label}) → playwright-core connectOverCDP to the 1070's off-screen, muted Chrome (owner-requested runs only). Boot URL carries `hud=none&plugins=none&nosw=1` plus filmMode. Use frame-indexed shot tables (moving-bench discipline). Write output to /mnt/wbterminal2 and mux audio offline.
- CLI style: `#!/usr/bin/env node`, WHY/WHAT/USAGE header, hand-rolled `--key=value` arg(k, default), exported main() behind the pathToFileURL main-guard, exit 0 ok / 1 finding / 2 usage-or-environment.
- JEV: wrap or mirror rynth/ai/llm_client.js conventions (typed error .kind, single retry, spend counters, timeout) without editing that frozen file. Key from env or localStorage. Mock it in tests with an in-process http.createServer as rynth_ai_client_test.cjs does.
- Claude Code: create $REPO/.claude/skills/film-mode/SKILL.md (frontmatter name + description; companion reference .md files; evals/evals.json and evals/trigger-eval.json via the enabled skill-creator plugin) and $REPO/.claude/agents/film-director.md (model: opus). Symlink both into ~/.claude/skills/film-mode and ~/.claude/agents/ so they work from /home/wbterminal. Embed the ~/CLAUDE.md resource rules verbatim and the no-push / no self-armed git rule.
- Before claiming done, the orchestrator (not parallel agents) runs, one at a time: node harness/run-js-headless.mjs --coverage, the full gate under capped-build, node ../../scripts/lint-url-flags.mjs (and --strict), audit-flag-defaults.mjs, lint-event-consumers.mjs, lint-harness-params.mjs and node scripts/gen-modulepreload.mjs --check. Parallel agents run only `node tests/film_x.test.mjs`.
- Commit in the parent repo on master (only when the user asks) with subject `holtburger-web: film mode — <outcomes>`, bullet body, Tests/Gate line, docs/HANDOFF-film-mode-YYYY-MM-DD.md pointer and the Co-Authored-By trailer.

## OPENQ
- Does esbuild 0.28.2 hard-error on an unresolvable literal dynamic import() (top-level film/ case)? Assumed yes, not tested; moot if film code lives under scene3d/film/.
- Does Claude Code discover the repo's lowercase `.claude/skills/worldbuilder-terminal/skill.md`, and does it surface nested-directory skills when the cwd is /home/wbterminal? This decides whether a symlink into ~/.claude is required or just belt-and-braces.
- Which agent frontmatter fields does this Claude Code build support (name/description/tools/model, and is `model: opus` the right alias given settings.json model 'opus[1m]')? No on-disk example exists.
- Should film mode build on the existing `?camDebug=on` window.__cam rig (scene3d/camera.js:1440+) or install its own camera driver? The camera recon area should decide; this affects whether camDebug gets reused or a parallel park() mechanism appears.
- Where does the JEV client run: in-page (localStorage key, browser fetch to OpenRouter) or only in the agent's Node tooling (env key)? The second keeps all API spend outside the web client and is simpler to audit.
- Is `?hud=none` enough for HUD-free frames, or do in-canvas overlays (selection brackets, the #selection-brackets-3d element in agent-mode CSS, nameplates drawn in WebGL) need film-side suppression? Not checked in this area.
